axes.name: is_open_call
axes.rationale: The target uses the same-segment NOP/PUSH CS/CALL near sequence; compare a far declaration that LINK can translate with direct near declaration.

axes.name: open_state_update
axes.rationale: The target uses a difference-gated update of state bit 2; compare the direct XOR expression with the best observed branch-based form.

axes.name: closed_state_update
axes.rationale: The closed path updates bit 2 using the same Boolean value; compare XOR and branch-based forms.

axes.name: changed_bitmap_index
axes.rationale: Target reads object+0x28 when selected and object+0x2a when clear; with an array base at +0x26 that is index 1 or 2.

axes.name: unchanged_bitmap_index
axes.rationale: The unchanged branch uses the same two bitmap words and state-dependent index.

semantic_summary: Update state bit 2 always; the open window redraws by type only on a changed selection and redraws only bitmap objects when selection is unchanged.
binding_evidence: Packet supplies MAPSYM names for all direct DGROUP operands and the target call/reference offsets. State bit 2 selects one of the words at object+0x28 and +0x2a.
